manufacturer.name: SOMMER
manufacturer.note: German garage door and gate drive manufacturer. Serves its assembly instructions as static PDFs from a Montageanleitung tree, split by product type and market and with an Archiv branch for superseded models; that tree is registered as a harvest target and looks like one of the better-structured ones in this registry.

documents.title: duo vision 500, 650, 800 and duo rapido 650 Assembly Instructions (EN)
documents.evidence: On sommer.eu, the manufacturer's own domain, English edition. Note the Archiv path segment: SOMMER files this under archived instructions, so it covers a superseded range and a current replacement may exist elsewhere in the tree. Recorded anyway, because installed duo vision drives still need it. One document covers all four drives, so they share this record as aliases. Not fetched - egress blocked.
